name: Generate satirical slogans and fictional media branding
description: Users asked to generate satirical slogans, fictional advertisements, and culturally or historically adapted versions of media brands, television programs, and corporate marketing materials. The requests frequently specified particular historical time periods, ownership contexts, or exaggerated tonal variations to mock or imagine alternative iterations of these commercial identities.
